items.title: SoFi Is Bypassing the Banking Bottleneck With Stablecoin Settlement
items.summary: SoFi Technologies is using its national bank charter to settle roughly $25 billion in annualized Mastercard transaction volume via its SoFiUSD stablecoin, cutting costs and drawing commercial deposits.
